title: レースとグルメで満腹に

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've brought Oguri Cap to observe a race as part of her training.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The track's shaped like a rice ball… How fascinating.
choice_data_list: You can buy a real rice ball inside, you know.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I've heard the Nakayama Racecourse has a great selection of food. I can't wait to see for myself.
choice_data_list: Let's take a look around the shops until the race starts.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's eyes twinkle with excitement as we walk through the concessions area.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The race will start soon. Do you think we have time to look at a few more?
choice_data_list: We should go now to make sure we get a good spot.
Let's enjoy the race and the food!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: But… All right. I guess the race is the reason we're here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There's still food left to see… but it's fine. Let's head to the stands.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Would you look at that! Here's Akemichi King, coming up from behind!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Akemi… "Chicken"?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Noppo Tetora is hot on her tail!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: No… "po-ta-to"?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Chicken… Potato… Deep-fried… Piping hot…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Mmrgh… Don't worry, it's nothing. Let's just watch the race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Chicken… Potato… It's difficult to discount either racer…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although Oguri Cap is clearly struggling with some ordeal, I do as she says and remain silent by her side.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The race is almost over. Will the winner be Chicken… or Potato?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Akemichi King clinches the victory! Akemichi Kiiiiing!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Ahhh, so Chicken won! Just as I predicted.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It seems Oguri Cap managed to resist the gastronomic temptation and focus on the race.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Potato ran amazingly, too. I could learn a few things from—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrowl…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: …I'm hungry.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I treat Oguri Cap to dinner for watching the race so attentively.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: There are still a few places I have my eye on. Let's check out as many as we can before the race starts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I go around the concession stands with Oguri Cap. She's so lively, it's like she's a whole new person.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: The race is just starting. All right, let's get ready to focus!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yes. My mind is sharper now that I have a full stomach.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Now I can predict what the racer in second place will do, or who will break out from the rear… Things like that.
choice_data_list: Who do you think is going to win?

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Good question. Judging by the current situation…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two of us discuss our predictions for the outcomes of the races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Then, after the final race…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I was right again… You see, she was sticking to the outer side of the track the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: It looks easier to run on the outside on this course, so I figured she'd have the advantage.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I should do pretty well when I get to race here.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I think I'll make you, the folks back home, and all my fans proud.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: That's why I have to keep putting my all into my…

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trai…ning… Yaaawn…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She may have put too much energy into analysis after eating. She seems to be on the verge of a food coma.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We leave the stands, dreaming of the day when the crowd will all be chanting Oguri Cap's name.
